summary.text: Lori Gramlich is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 131, York County, representing Old Orchard Beach.
The page lists Lori Gramlich's title as Assistant Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Lori Gramlich's education as Masters (Social Work, 1997).
The page lists Lori Gramlich's occupation as Social Worker, Adjunct Faculty USM School of Social Work.
Lori Gramlich lives in Old Orchard Beach and has served 4 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Engrossed Bills (member); State and Local Government (member).
Family details on the page: married, spouse Bob Kelly, 1 child.
